The FreeSurfer template data files in this directory are distributed under
the terms of the FreeSurfer Software License. The copyright holder is
The General Hospital Corporation, Boston MA, USA ("MGH").

This includes the fsaverage and fsaverage6 surface meshes, the per-vertex
morphometry data (e.g., *_thickness), the cortex labels, and the
pre-computed vertex adjacency (*_meshdist_edge_1.vv) files, which are
derivative works of those meshes.

See inst/COPYRIGHTS in this package for the full license text, and
https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/FreeSurferSoftwareLicense for
the canonical text.
